reason: EUR 120 is a lot when my phone already does the alarm and the weather for free. I like how it looks, but I'd be paying a lot to fix a habit I've already failed to fix with willpower.
objection: My phone already does all of this for free, and I'm not sure a new object would actually get the phone out of my bedroom. I'd probably still bring it to bed.
would_change_my_mind: A price around EUR 70 to 80, or a trial period with free returns so I could find out whether I really leave the phone in another room.
